2607.14044.title: AI-accelerated End-to-End Framework for Rapid Professional Upskilling
2607.14044.paper_summary: By 2030, 59 of every 100 workers will need reskilling or upskilling, yet the average time to close an enterprise skills gap grew from roughly 3 days in 2014 to 36 days in 2018. Most current frameworks accelerate single stages of upskilling programs and generally lack industry validation. We present an end-to-end framework that applies AI acceleration across five stages of knowledge acquisition, content development, content review and verification, teaching, and assessment development; with a strong focus on both production and learning efficiency. Three strong external signals validates the framework: the US National Association of State Boards of Accountancy reviewed and approved an upskilling program built on the framework for continuing-professional-education credits; 3 learners followed the program and passed the NVIDIA Certified Professional in Agentic AI exam in a significantly short amount of time, with 14 more in progress; the program's knowledge base supports complex downstream analysis such as the production of a robust 1,267 risk item dataset for managing multi-agent AI system risks.
2607.14044.paper_summary_zh: 到2030年，每100名工作者中將有59人需要重新技能培訓或提升技能，但關閉企業技能差距的平均時間從2014年的約3天增長到2018年的36天。大多數當前的框架加速了技能提升計劃的單一階段，並且通常缺乏行業驗證。我們提出了一個端到端的框架，該框架在知識獲取、內容開發、內容審查和驗證、教學以及評估開發的五個階段中應用AI加速，並強調生產和學習效率。三個強有力的外部信號驗證了該框架：美國國家會計委員會協會審查並批准了一個基於該框架的技能提升計劃，以獲得持續專業教育學分；3名學習者參加了該計劃並在顯著短的時間內通過了NVIDIA認證專業人員的Agentic AI考試，還有14名學習者正在進行中；該計劃的知識基礎支持複雜的下游分析，例如生成一個強大的1,267個風險項目數據集，以管理多代理AI系統風險。
